claim_boundary: This fixed-token Mistral assay can compare two final answer-token projection precisions from one identical native upper-decoder and final-normalized hidden state for eight frozen cases, five horizons, four controls, seven lanes, and two existing checkpoints. The FP32 lane is only a two-choice diagnostic head, not a full-FP32 decoder or a deployable route. The assay does not train, validate free generation, establish semantic memory, generalization, capability, K/V accumulation, portability, or speed. It cannot rescue the failed grouped F1-F5 gates; the scientific winner remains none.

summary.head_comparison: Both score paths consume one identical native upper-decoder and final-normalized hidden state; only the selected lm-head matmul and output dtype differ.
